newsitem.title: UK: Cazenove Indian GDR Index down 1.89 percent.
newsitem.headline: Cazenove Indian GDR Index down 1.89 percent.

text.p: The Cazenove Indian GDR Index fell 1.51 points, or 1.89 percent, to 78.36 after the Bombay Stock Exchange 30 share index rose 34.78 points, or 1.02 percent, to a provisional 3,453.10.
The premium for GDRs over stocks on the local market was 15.97 percent.
The Cazenove index is a capitalisation weighted basket of Indian global depositary receipts and measures the change from midday on the previous trading day to midday today.
